newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to cut deficit/GDP ratio to 2.9 pct in '97. [corrected 13:46 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Belgium to cut deficit/GDP ratio to 2.9 pct in '97. [corrected 13:46 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects headline to read 2.9 pct instead of 3 pct)

The Belgian government is to take measures in the 1997 budget which will enable it to cut the ratio of the country's budget deficit to gross domestic product to 2.9 percent, a government statement said on Tuesday.
The release, part of the policy statement on the 1997 budget being presented to parliament, said the ratio would be at three percent in 1996.
